hero.title: We listen and act
hero.text: At Ministry of HR, we believe that every successful business begins with empowered and engaged people. Our HR consulting services are designed to help organizations navigate the complexities of human resources with confidence. Whether you need guidance on HR processes, or strategic HR planning, we provide tailored solutions that align with your unique goals.

offering.title: OUR OFFERING
offering.subtitle: From us, you can enjoy the following:

1.title: Interim HR Manager / HR Director Support
1.description: stepping in as an experienced leader to guide organizations through periods of change, transformation, or restructuring

2.title: Building HR Departments in Poland
2.description: helping international companies establish and grow their HR presence locally or supporting companies operating in Poland that do not yet have a dedicated HR function, guiding them through the complete process of establishing a professional HR department

3.title: HR Business Partnering
3.description: aligning HR initiatives with business priorities for measurable impact

4.title: Expert Evaluation of HR Systems & Processes
4.description: independent assessment of HR systems, tools, and processes before implementation, as well as improving those already in place to ensure they meet business needs and best practices

5.title: Competency Matrices & Development Frameworks
5.description: building clear structures to assess and grow employee skills

6.title: Temporary HR Support & Project Management
6.description: hands-on assistance in driving specific HR projects or bridging resource gaps

text.line1: I had the pleasure of consulting with Marta on how to improve our employee evaluation automation app. The session was extremely valuable – Marta shared plenty of inspiring ideas that helped us better understand how to shape our product positioning and build a solid feature backlog.
text.line2: She is a true expert in her field – knowledgeable, insightful, and with a fresh perspective. Working with her was a great experience!
